explanation: Erdős #217: for which n are there n points in general position (no 3 collinear, no 4 concyclic) determining n − 1 distinct distances with multiplicities 1, 2, …, n−1? The Lean requires exactly n − 1 distances whose multiplicity image is {1, …, n−1}, which forces a bijection. InGeneralPosition is NonTrilinear ∧ NoFourConcyclic, which matches. The site records constructions for n ≤ 8 (Palásti and others), with general n open. The statement is faithful.
